newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Cos EPS view pared.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Cos EPS view pared.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co analyst Steven Eisman lowered his 1996 earnings estimate for United Cos Financial Corp to $2.62 per share from $2.75, according to the analyst's office.
-- The company's buy rating and $3.30 per share 1997 earnings estimate are unchanged.
-- In late morning Nasdaq trade, the stock was off 4-3/8 to 32-3/4.
-- The analyst was not immediately available for additional comment.
